keyVerseDR: "His mother saith to the waiters: Whatsoever he shall say to you, do ye." (Jn 2:5)

level1.title: Water Into Wine
level1.story: Jesus, Mary, and the disciples went to a wedding. The wine ran out! Mary said, "Do whatever He tells you." Jesus turned water into wine.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How can you do what Jesus says?
level1.prayer: Mary, help me do what Jesus says. Amen.

activity.title: Wedding faces
activity.intro: Draw the faces: worried, then happy!

level2.title: The Wedding at Cana
level2.story: There was a wedding in Cana of Galilee, and the mother of Jesus was there, and Jesus and His disciples were invited. When the wine ran out, Mary said to Jesus, "They have no wine." She told the servants, "Whatsoever He shall say to you, do ye." Jesus had them fill six stone water jars with water and take some to the chief steward. The water had become wine, the best wine, and this was the first of Jesus' signs.
level2.keyLine: Whatsoever he shall say to you, do ye.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How does Mary help us go to Jesus?
actions: Ask Mary to pray for a need
level2.prayer: Mary, lead me to do whatever Jesus says. Amen.

activity.title: Fix the words
activity.intro: Three words are wrong. Cross them out and write the right ones.
activity.text: His {father|mother} saith to the {guests|waiters}: Whatsoever He shall say to you, {wait|do} ye.
